import chrono as ch
import chrono_vehicle as chv
import chrono_ros as chr
import rospy
from rospy_message_converter import message_converter

# Initialize PyChrono environment and core components
ch.ChronoEnvironment.set_G_acc(9.81)

# Create the simulation
simulation = ch.ChronoSimulation()

# Set up the HMMWV vehicle
vehicle_file = "path/to/hmmwv/vehicle.json"
vehicle = chv.ChronoVehicle(simulation, vehicle_file)

# Set vehicle parameters
vehicle.SetContactMethod(ch.ContactMethod.SMC)
vehicle.SetEngineType(ch.EngineType.ELECTRIC)
vehicle.SetTireModel(ch.TireModel.Rigid)

# Create the terrain
terrain_file = "path/to/terrain/terrain.obj"
terrain = ch.ChronoTerrain(simulation, terrain_file)
terrain.SetFriction(0.8)
terrain.SetRestitution(0.7)

# Initialize the driver system
driver = chv.ChronoDriver(vehicle)

# Initialize ROS integration
rospy.init_node('chrono_simulation')

# Register ROS handlers
def clock_cb(msg):
    simulation.SetTimestep(msg.data)

def driver_inputs_cb(msg):
    driver.SetInputs(msg.steering, msg.throttle, msg.brake)

def vehicle_state_cb(msg):
    vehicle.SetState(msg.pose, msg.twist)

chr.ROSManager().RegisterHandler('clock', clock_cb)
chr.ROSManager().RegisterHandler('driver_inputs', driver_inputs_cb)
chr.ROSManager().RegisterHandler('vehicle_state', vehicle_state_cb)

# Simulation loop
rate = rospy.Rate(100)  # 100 Hz
while not rospy.is_shutdown():
    # Synchronize and advance systems
    simulation.Advance(0.01)  # 10 ms timestep
    driver.Update()
    terrain.Update()

    # Update ROS manager
    chr.ROSManager().Update()

    rate.sleep()

        hmmwv.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)  # Synchronize the vehicle with inputs and terrain.

        # Advance the simulation for all modules by one timestep.
        driver.Advance(time_step)
        terrain.Advance(time_step)
        hmmwv.Advance(time_step)

        # Update the ROS manager to handle data publishing.
        if not ros_manager.Update(time, time_step):
            break  # Exit loop if ROS manager update fails.

        # Render the current frame
        vis.Render(time_step)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
